projects.title: Delegation & Access Control System
projects.description: Designed hierarchical multi-tenant access control system, enabling 10x scalability in account relationships. Migrated from 1:1 mapping to hierarchy-based architecture, reducing authorization complexity by ~40%.

projects.title: Dark Web Monitoring System
projects.description: Integrated breach detection APIs to monitor thousands of domains and emails. Built near real-time alerting system with less than 5 minutes delay, significantly improving incident response time.

projects.title: Event-Driven Microservices
projects.description: Created event-driven workflows using AWS SQS and DynamoDB Streams, improving system throughput by ~50%. Implemented robust validation and edge case handling.

projects.title: Full-Stack Serverless Platform
projects.description: Planned and built a full-stack platform using Angular and FastAPI with serverless backend, reducing infrastructure cost by ~40% and deployment time by ~50% through CI/CD pipelines.

projects.title: IT Inventory Management System
projects.description: Deployed internal IT inventory management system for DRDO network, automating asset tracking processes and reducing manual workload by 40-50%, leading to improved data accuracy.
